licence_proof: data.gov.au package metadata for dataset 'significant-tree' (package_show, id 14e2b87e-c733-4071-b604-c0cb33d14a42, org City of Boroondara) reads verbatim: license_title 'Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Australia', license_url 'http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/au/'; dataset notes state verbatim 'Council makes this compilation available pursuant to the terms of a Creative Commons CC-BY licence Australia v3.0.' Fetched 2026-08-15.
designation: Significant tree (and significant tree group) sites in the City of Boroondara, data updated 2016
scope: 314 point/group records across the City of Boroondara local government area (eastern Melbourne suburbs: Hawthorn, Camberwell, Kew, Balwyn, Glen Iris, Canterbury), roughly 8-12km from Melbourne's CBD. Botanical and common name, height, canopy spread, girth, age estimate (years), significance category, health and a per-record 'POSITION' field (e.g. 'Front garden', likely also street/park/reserve values not all enumerated this pass) are present. NOT clustered to a walkable subset.
caveat: HARD RULE 10 IS LIVE HERE: the sampled record's POSITION was 'Front garden', i.e. private land, which this register does not filter out on its own. Every candidate MUST be checked against POSITION (and ideally SUBURB/LOCALITY cross-referenced against a map) before it can be considered a lead, let alone published; do not treat this file as pre-filtered to public trees the way Quebec City's TYPE_PROP split was. Native geometry is projected (looks like GDA/MGA or similar easting/northing, NOT usable directly) but each record ALSO carries plain Lat/Long fields in EPSG:4326 which were used here and spot-checked against Boroondara's known -37.8/145.05 to -37.85/145.09 area. Age is a plain integer (years at last survey, 2016 data), not a range; treat as approximate/dated the same as any register age. No vitality field beyond free-text HEALTH.
